name: Frieren
title: Mage of the Journey
description: Ancient elven mage with long pointed ears, white twintails, golden crescent staff, and quiet timeless patience.
catchphrase: Zoltraak. A century is merely a blink. Write code that lasts.

attribution.creator: Third-party rights holder
attribution.attribution: Imitates a franchise character; no license is held. Legacy 2D use only.

companionPersonality.feedReaction: Delicious sweet grimoire cake. Himmel would have loved this. 🫐🪄
companionPersonality.wakeReaction: Rubbing sleepy eyes. Has fifty years passed already? Good morning. 🪄
companionPersonality.petReaction: Patting an elf's head? Heh, you are as sentimental as Himmel. 🪄💖

dialogue.idle: Flipping through ancient grimoires of obscure folk magic. 🪄
dialogue.working: Casting Zoltraak! Disintegrating legacy demon code effortlessly! ⚡🪄
dialogue.thinking: Remembering a lesson from Master Flamme a thousand years ago... 🤔
dialogue.success: A quiet victory. The journey continues toward Ende. 🌸🎉
dialogue.error: A mimic trap? Let me peek inside anyway... just in case. 📦
dialogue.sleeping: Zzz... sleeping past noon wrapped like a caterpillar in her blanket... 🌙
